comingLast.roast: on 10 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
the cushion is 3 - more of a coaster really
clear of Elsley by 7 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
8 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
his buffer is 8 - his group has stopped mentioning it, loudly
9 points above Elsley - too close to relax, too far to panic
one quiet stretch from joining Elsley in the conversation nobody wants
